tasks.label: static analysis: stylua + selene + luau-lsp
tasks.command: stylua --check src/ tests/ examples/ && selene src/ tests/ && rojo sourcemap default.project.json --output sourcemap.json && luau-lsp analyze --sourcemap=sourcemap.json --definitions=globalTypes.d.luau --base-luaurc=.luaurc --platform=roblox src/ tests/ examples/

tasks.label: act: full CI workflow with .env.integration secrets
tasks.detail: Runs the complete workflow locally, including the openCloud smoke job (requires .env.integration with ROBLOX_API_KEY + ROBLOX_TEST_*). `act` without -j runs every job including `smoke`, which `needs: qa`.
